name: NEWSFEED
title: A Jury Rebukes Kristin Knouse
dek: $6 million for David Sabatini, the MIT scientist she accused.

body.text: In October 2026 a Massachusetts jury found that biologist Kristin Knouse defamed David Sabatini, the cancer researcher who lost his posts at MIT and the Whitehead Institute in 2021 after she reported their relationship. Jurors awarded him $6 million.

Knouse, then a postdoc at Whitehead, had a relationship with Sabatini that ended in 2019. A 2021 investigation by the law firm Hinckley Allen led to his removal, and in 2022 a planned hire at NYU drew protests. The jury rejected her coercion and assault claims. According to Janice Fiamengo, Knouse is appealing.
Fiamengo's column on the verdict argues that science institutions have been slow to reckon with it.

name: TOOLZ
title: We Need to Talk About Claude
dek: You can build websites now without knowing how to code.

body.text: Something revelatory has happened. I don’t think it happened yesterday, but it definitely didn’t exist two or three years ago.
Somewhere along the line, I discovered you can build digital website infrastructure without knowing how to code. I knew this day was coming. It’s here, and it’s exciting.
I’ve been able to build out 20 Blok, and I’ve expanded other projects too. It’s a massive era of freedom.
Check out the tutorial below, where I talk about it.

name: OFF THE PATH
title: Transmute Your Reality
dek: This issue’s word, and Danny Dodge of @radical.self.

body.text: Every issue gets a word. This issue’s word is transmute. I’ve been doing Danny Dodge’s mantras, and I’m not going to gatekeep.

body.alt: A dictionary-style card: THIS ISSUE’S WORD, transmute, verb, to change something into another form, nature or substance.

body.text: transmute (trans·mute), verb. To change something into another form, nature or substance.

items: Everyday use: to turn one thing into something different, often something better.
In alchemy: to turn one element into another, the old dream of turning lead into gold.
From Latin transmutare: trans-, “across,” and mutare, “to change.”

body.text: Danny Dodge runs Radical Self (@radical.self on Instagram, about 29,000 followers). His bio is two words: “Become Inevitable.” His reels are short guided sessions shot close to the camera, many from the driver’s seat of his car: “60 Second Millionaire Hypnosis,” “Master the Law of Assumption,” “Third Eye Visualization Technique,” “listen 3x and watch what happens.”

body.alt: Six reels from Danny Dodge's Instagram, close-ups with titles like 60 Second Millionaire Hypnosis and Master the Law of Assumption.
